site.role: experiment: EXP-055's villager, carrying the experiment offers only. The approved lines stand at counter_site
site.why: Holdfast is the gym 8 town (data/markets.json counter 'holdfast', badge 8, at (3634, 113, 6462)): the last stores before Victory Road, so late-game by place as well as by input. The booth is a 3x3x3 room 9 blocks under the counter's heightmap ground, not on the street: a villager struck by lightning is discarded even though MobsBeGone refuses the witch it would become (EXP-055 'Lightning'), and lightning cannot reach a villager that cannot see the sky and is more than 3 blocks under any strike point. Underground also keeps the booth off every street, lot and NPC the town plan seats, which this worktree cannot read (derived/towns is absent). The place function refuses to carve if any shell cell is air, water or lava (a cave, a cellar, an aquifer) and says so in a score

counter_site.role: production: the barterer players trade with, carrying every approved line
counter_site.why: the owner, 2026-10-08: 'Players trade at Northlight's counter. One place.' Northlight's counter (data/markets.json northlight_station, Station Supply and Exchange, at (7277, 117, 1540)) stands in the open on the plaza, where a villager would be discarded by the first bolt that lands within reach (EXP-055 'Lightning'). So the barterer stands inside the counter's own Mart (the counter's near_trader, data/traders.json northlight_mart; the building data/placements.json northlight_pokemart, template kits/structures/campaign/f4/services/towns/northlight_mart.nbt), 15 blocks north of the counter keeper, on the shop floor in front of the Mart counter and 3 west of the aisle from the door (x7280) to the clerk. Read from the plan, never a world: the template's blocks turned by the placement, its floor from the clerk record (y116 = floor + 1, as tools/sea_town.py clerk_record seats it; the heightmap reads y115 at the door too). The generator refuses the spot unless every column within lightning_reach of it holds a template block lightning_clearance or more above the villager's feet (the booth's rule, applied to a roof), the feet and head cells are air and the floor is solid; the place function refuses in the world unless every one of those roof blocks, the floor and the air are there, and says so in a score
counter_site.access: walk in through the Mart's door off Northlight's plaza

counter_barterer.name: Station Exchange
counter_barterer.why: the counter's barter half: the counter keeper is 'Station Supply and Exchange' (data/markets.json). Snow type for the aurora town; cartographer for a research station's surveyor (any profession but none or nitwit has a trades table, EXP-055 'Profession'); level 5 as the experiment's; yaw 0 faces south, down the shop floor to the door

why.priceMultiplier: 0 zeroes both the demand surcharge and the reputation (gossip) discount, which are each multiplied by it (EXP-055 'Price'); it does NOT touch Hero of the Village
why.maxUses: high enough that the shared stock never runs out between restocks (stock is per villager, so a small stock would let one player empty it for everyone); any restock only resets uses
why.xp: 0 so trading never raises the villager's experience
why.rewardExp: false: no experience orbs for the player
why.uses_specialPrice_demand: written as 0 so no default is relied on

rules.buy_count_one: every barter line's `buy` (cost A) has count 1 and its bulk cost goes in `buyB`. Hero of the Village takes max(1, floor((0.3 + 0.0625 * amplifier) * count)) off cost A whatever priceMultiplier is, but cost A is clamped to at least 1 and cost B is never discounted (EXP-055 'Price'), so a count-1 cost A cannot move
rules.distinct_inputs: `buy` and `buyB` are different items: the trade screen's auto-fill moves every matching stack into the first slot up to a full stack, so a line paying the same item in both slots leaves the second slot empty for a player holding fewer than a stack plus the second cost
rules.experiment_offers_never_gain: every experiment offer's output is one of its own inputs, at a count no larger than the worst-case (fully discounted) count paid of it, so it can stand in any world, the live one included

pricing.rule: a line's inputs, valued at what the player gives up for them, lie between band[0] and band[1] times the output's reference price: never cheaper than the counter, so the barter is an alternative path and not a bypass (the owner, 2026-10-08), and at most a tenth dearer. The barter's advantage is that it never touches money, not that it is cheaper
pricing.input_value: the Bank's buy-back price (modpack/config/cobbledollars/bank.json, tools/bank.py's output) for an item the Bank buys; 9 times its ingredient's for a storage block, which uncrafts to 9; the counter price (data/markets.json) for an item only a counter sells, which is what replacing it costs. The generator checks every value below against those files and refuses a stale one
pricing.reference: per line: `reference.lines`, line ids on `reference.counter`'s stock or superseded_stock (a money line as it stood), summed; or `reference.bank`, [{item, count}] valued at the bank's price (the Master Ball: 2 ingots, E4). Where the counter no longer sells the output (the held items, the Capsule, E5) the superseded line is the rung; where it never did, the counter's line of the same kind and weight, named per line with why. No top-tier output has a money line (the owner's 2026-10-07 'no money where possible'; E4 and E5 2026-10-13); whether the counter should also sell Specs and the Knot for money is decisions_pending held_items_money_line

experiment_offers.purpose: the fixed line under test: a modded item on both sides, two inputs, the fixed-trade fields. Cost A is 4 so drift either way is visible; the player always loses 4 Poke Balls (or 1 if fully discounted), never gains

the control: the same villager, priceMultiplier 0.2 instead of 0. If its cost falls below 4 after trades while exp_two_inputs stays at 4, multiplier 0 is what holds the fixed line; if neither moves, a NoAI villager collects no trade gossip either. Worst case 1 Poke Ball for 1: never a gain

reference.why: the owner's E4 (2026-10-13): 'about 2 netherite ingots, 30 is too steep'. Two ingots is also the netherite in Cobblemon's own recipe (data/cobblemon/recipe/master_ball.json in Cobblemon-fabric-1.8.0+1.21.1.jar, read 2026-10-13: a nether star and two shulker shells between two c:ingots/netherite). The star and shells are unreachable here (data/bank.json unreachable), so the barter keeps the recipe's metal and drops what the world cannot supply. The counter's money line is gone, so the reference is the recipe's netherite at the bank's price: 2 x $900 = $1,800

lines.inputs_why: an ingot ($900) and five scrap ($202 each, $1,010): $1,910, 1.06 of the reference. The smallest scrap count in the band: four scrap is $1,708, 0.95, under the 1.00 floor. Cost A is the ingot at count 1 and cost B is a different item (rules.distinct_inputs), so '2 ingots' becomes an ingot plus scrap (two ingots are 8 scrap and 8 gold ingots; this is 9 scrap and 4 gold ingots). Raw cost: 9 ancient debris and 4 gold ingots; ASSUMED rates (data/bank.json: 10 debris an hour with a pickaxe, 30 by bed or TNT, 10 raw gold an hour mined) make that 0.9 h (0.3 h by TNT), +0.4 h if the gold is mined and not ranched. The line it replaces was 1 netherite block and 21 ingots (30 ingots, 120 debris: 12.0 h, 4.0 h by TNT, +12.0 h for gold)
